explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/917 and LMY23 Theorem 1.1, which I checked in the PDF: for k ≥ 4 and large n, f_k(n) ≤ e(T_{k-2}(n)) - c_k n² with c_k ≥ 1/(36(k-1)²). The statement uses ex(n;K_{k-1}) = e(T_{k-2}(n)) minus n²/(36(k-1)²), matching Theorem 1.1. That is stronger than the page's form, which has an extra factor ½ on the correction term. Faithful.
